title: Best Split by Gini Impurity
signature: def best_split(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> tuple
hints: Gini(S) = 1 - sum_c p_c^2, where p_c is the class fraction in S. The split score weights each side by its share of the samples.
The candidate thresholds for a feature are the midpoints between consecutive sorted unique values. A constant feature has none.
Scan features in order and thresholds ascending. Replace the best only when the new score is lower by more than 1e-12, so ties keep the earliest candidate.
